title: Good things are downloading.
lead: Your workspace is ready to explore. Your model will keep downloading while you’re here.
readyLead: Everything is in place for your first conversation.

email.label: Prefer to come back later?
email.hint: By clicking Notify me, you agree to one email when this model is ready. Keep Atomic Chat running for the download to finish. Your address is used only for this reminder.
email.done: Reminder set. We’ll email you when the model is ready.
email.error: Could not save the reminder. Check your connection and try again.
email.invalid: Check your email address and try again.
email.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again in an hour.

mines.title: Atomic Mines
mines.help: Numbers count nearby atoms. Right-click or use flag mode to mark them. Your first move is always safe.
